title: Trails Through Time Bellevue Coal Creek History Hike
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a family-friendly, 3.5-mile guided hike through Newcastle’s historic Coal Creek area, where Washington’s mining past meets the forested present. Along this outdoor adventure, participants explore the hidden history of coal mining, observe how nature has reclaimed the land, and appreciate the vibrant ecosystem of native plants and wildlife that now thrive in this restored landscape. 

A minimum of 4 participants is required for each tour to run. If that minimum is not met, you will be refunded.
